featured_reviews.review_text: We went for a late dinner at 10:30 on a Sunday. The place was moderately crowdy but we easily got a table. The ambience is semi decent but the staff who takes order is sophisticated rude. IIf you tell him that the food was salty he will say that we as customer should have told them in advance if we wanted low salted food because no one else complained, which is hilarious because why would you expect chinese food to be not salty right? We order veg nonveg both gravy, and trust me on it , IT WAS SALTY. And you know chinese food salty is not something you can mix and fix with rice or noodles. The noodles we ordered were not properly done it was chewy in a way that noodles should not be. I would have maybe ignored the low food quality but the way the person in charge interacted when we complained ticked me off. Oh he also messed up my food. I explicitly told him i wanted chicken in my noodles, two time yet i was served a veg and when i told him, he told me that i asked for veg and it was me who was wrong. thankfully my table people defended me but like what is behavior? I am not a karen or I dont expect Michelin level at a local chinese shop but I think i deserve basically decency and not a mix up with my food. Their starters are good. I saw a lot of people were getting it. Overall I would not suggest not eating here, because neither you will get decent food nor service. Its not worth it. But if you wanna try do it at your own risk.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This was one of the worst restaurant experiences I’ve had.

We ordered Chicken Tikka Khepsa, and everything about the order was disappointing. The delivery was extremely late — over an hour delay with no proper communication or apology. That alone shows how little they care about customers.

The pricing felt like a complete scam. Online, the dish was listed at ₹415, but when we ordered offline, we were charged ₹640. There was no transparency, and it honestly feels like they intentionally mislead customers to overcharge them.

We only agreed to order offline because we were promised 8 pieces of chicken. When the food arrived, there were just 6 pieces. This is straight-up false commitment and very unprofessional behavior.

On top of that, the quantity was poor and not worth the price at all. And the taste? Absolutely terrible. It didn’t taste anything like Chicken Tikka — bland, poorly prepared, and not enjoyable in any way.

Overall, this place is overpriced, dishonest, and serves low-quality food. Between the delay, wrong quantity, misleading pricing, and bad taste, it was a complete waste of money. I strongly recommend avoiding this restaurant.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Sadaye
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this restaurant. We ordered Chicken Tikka Khepsa, and the entire process turned out to be frustrating.

First of all, the delivery was delayed by over an hour, which is unacceptable. Secondly, the pricing was misleading. Online, the dish was listed at ₹415, but when we ordered offline, we were charged ₹640 — a significant difference with no proper justification.

We chose to order offline because we were told the dish would include 8 pieces of chicken. However, when the order arrived, there were only 6 pieces, which felt like false information just to get us to place the order.

To make matters worse, the quantity overall was quite low, and the taste was very disappointing. It didn’t resemble Chicken Tikka at all and lacked flavor.

Overall, this was a poor experience in terms of service, pricing transparency, quantity, and taste. I would not recommend this place based on my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kings Family Chinese Restaurant in Bhandup is the perfect spot for anyone who loves authentic and flavorful Chinese cuisine. Whether you’re dining with family or catching up with friends, this cozy and welcoming restaurant promises a satisfying experience.

1.	Authentic Flavors:
The restaurant offers a wide variety of Chinese dishes, each packed with authentic flavors and prepared to perfection. The fried rice, chicken lollipop, and Schezwan noodles are absolute must-tries!
2.	Affordable Pricing:
Kings Family Restaurant provides delicious meals at pocket-friendly prices, making it an excellent choice for both casual dining and special occasions.
3.	Generous Portions:
The portion sizes are generous, ensuring you get great value for your money. Perfect for sharing with family and friends.
4.	Quick and Polite Service:
The staff is courteous, attentive, and ensures prompt service. They’re always ready to recommend the best dishes on the menu.

Final Thoughts:

Kings Family Chinese Restaurant is a hidden gem in Bhandup for Chinese food lovers. With its authentic taste, reasonable pricing, and friendly service, it’s a go-to spot for a fulfilling and memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for families, friends, or anyone craving delicious Chinese cuisine!

featured_reviews.name: Sudarshan Koltharkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Kings Chinese, and it was an experience worth sharing. From the moment I stepped in, the warm and inviting ambiance set the stage for a delightful meal.

Ambiance:
Kings Chinese boasts a cozy yet elegant interior, with tasteful decor that combines traditional Chinese elements with a modern twist. The soft lighting and comfortable seating made for a relaxing dining atmosphere.

Service:
The staff at Kings Chinese were attentive and courteous. From the moment we were seated, they made sure we had everything we needed. They were knowledgeable about the menu and provided excellent recommendations.

The star of the show was, of course, the food. Kings Chinese offers a diverse menu that caters to a wide range of tastes. Here are a few standout dishes:

Kespa rice Chicken:** A perfect balance of spicy, savory, with tender chicken pieces and schezwan sauce. The flavors were vibrant and well-rounded.

Duck Rice: This dish was a highlight. The duck was cooked to perfection, with succulent meat.

Egg Fried Rice:A simple dish, but done exceptionally well. The rice was fluffy and flavorful, with just the right amount of seasoning.

Overall Experience:
Kings Chinese exceeded my expectations in every way. The combination of excellent food, top-notch service, and a pleasant atmosphere makes it a standout choice for anyone craving authentic Chinese cuisine. Whether you're looking for a casual meal with friends or a more formal dining experience, Kings Chinese is sure to impress.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday, we visited Shifu Express Hotel, Bhandup, to celebrate my son’s birthday with 11 family members, including children. Unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing.

Today, almost all family members are facing stomach upset issues after the dinner. Before placing the order, I personally informed the staff not to make the food spicy, especially because children were included. However, the soup was extremely spicy, and even the starters were too spicy.

In the main course, we ordered Veg Chopper Rice and Box Rice, but both tasted exactly the same. We could not understand the difference between the two dishes. Also, the rice did not seem properly cooked and felt stale.

Additionally, whenever I have ordered non-veg food from Shifu Express earlier, there has been a strong unpleasant smell, and even the next day the smell remained on the fingers.

My family members were already worried when I told them the party was planned at Shifu Express, and sadly this experience proved them right. I will never order from Shifu Express again.

featured_reviews.review_text: Heard lot about "ranjeet" so it was always in list & finally got a chance because it was holy "Shravan" month, so went for Pure Veg Chinese but had terrible experience. We started with 3 different soups in which one was "special ranjeet soup", manchow & Schezwan soup, trust me all three was same just different colour. I may not visit this restaurant again & won't recommend, i may give try again some other time if situation demands just for checking improvement. It's quite understandable that since it's pure veg & jain also available so you may expect crowd from vegans since it has no competition at all with any non-veg restaurant. I request owner to work on taste specially "schezwan" part which is most basic ingredient for almost all Chinese dishes & also lower your rate atleast by 10% & please have some more waiters.
